title: Learner 01 | Day 061: Configuration, secret handling, and audit events
body:
## Goal

Load typed settings, fail clearly when required configuration is missing, and emit a redacted login audit event.

## Implementation contract

**File:** `src/learnforge/adapters/storage/identity_and_access.py`

**Method/unit:** `access_safe_settings`

**Why here:** This changes or reads stored state: file/SQL/index/cache details and atomicity belong behind the storage boundary, separate from business rules.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Missing signing configuration prevents startup; logs contain actor and outcome but no token or password.

**Boundaries:** Own the state/read/write only; do not duplicate calculations or presentation.

## Research hints

1. Research **Configuration, secret handling, and audit events**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:cheatsheetseries.owasp.org Configuration secret handling and audit events`; use [OWASP cheat sheets](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/) for the relevant small section.
3. Predict one changed input/timing case, run it, and explain each changed value before applying the finding.

## Done

- [ ] Demonstrate this unit’s normal and boundary/failure cases in the working feature.
- [ ] Show the actual run and explain one changed case using concrete values.

**Question of the Day:** What makes a learning PR easy to review?
